title_en: At the Xelux Complex, on Elbasan Street, near the Austrian Embassy, ​​Super Apartment 3+1+2 Finished for sale!!
description_en: At the Xeluks Complex, on Elbasan Street, near the Austrian Embassy, ​​a 3+1+2 Finished super apartment is for sale. The apartment with a gross area of ​​168.05m2, net 143.9m2 is located on the 6th floor of a 7-story building. The apartment is organized in the corridor, which is distributed in the living room together with the kitchen corner, a bedroom with a dedicated toilet, 2 bedrooms and a main toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-East, which makes it sunny and bright most of the day. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality works, starting from inkaso plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc. The apartment has been completed and is ready for occupancy.
